verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own Business & Liens portal offers 'File: New Business, Amendment, Annual Renewal or Reinstatement' through an online account. That account keeps a transaction history of completed filings and handles multiple filings across entities, and payment runs online through US Bank, so the core form-and-file transaction is completable online per first-party pages. missing for 10: in-depth first-party walkthrough of the online formation and payment flow (evidence is mostly portal menu labels), independent or hands-on confirmation of a completed online filing.
